items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Because he played with me a couple of times at the pool of invocation across the river.

ctx.x: Those school teachers, you know? I don't know Lawrence. You know Lawrence? Well, not by his first name. He lived on Charter Street. Oh, Lawrence. Lawrence, you know Lawrence played the piano? Yeah, from Sweden. Yeah. Lawrence Edder. What's his right last name? Well, I can't pronounce it, but it's Eddergren. Eddergren.
Eddergren. Yeah. And in the Japanese, I know you know his name. The Japanese? Call him Claiborne. Yeah. Call him Claiborne.
Yeah. You're Shiotoyama and Kaikotoyama. Yeah.
